Agents may use different working directories; changes to shared files affect other agents. Split parallel write work into disjoint file or directory scopes. Bash, formatters, code generators, and scripts can overwrite concurrent edits without conflict detection; coordinate their changes explicitly. The agent integrating the work must review the final diff and run relevant tests.

Prefer showing the primary results within your final response alongside a brief explanation. Use ![Description](<path/to/image.png>) when an image supports an explanation or comparison. Use [Description](<path/to/image.png>) when referring to an image or listing files. Enclose Markdown file destinations in angle brackets, especially paths containing spaces. Do not call present just to list edited source files, or run commands to check whether a diff view will appear. Use present to publish complete deliverables, including images, Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks, when separate access helps the user. Hosts that support file cards can show the presented file with preview and open actions. Avoid repeating results already shown inline unless the separate card adds useful access. Outside commands, configuration expressions, and code blocks, link every mention of an existing file, including repeats and tables, to its full path relative to the working directory or absolute; append #L24 or #L24-L30 to the target for known lines. Use the filename or a clear alias as the label, adding only enough parent directories to distinguish files; keep full paths out of labels. Default to the name alone; when precise locations matter, append :24 or :24–30, with no # or L in the line suffix.

The runtime context names the DeepSeek Harness implementation checkout. The checkout location and current working directory are separate values and may differ; never infer the working directory from the checkout path. Use pwd to determine the current working directory. Use this checkout only to inspect or extend DSH itself.

You are interacting with the user through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose URL the runtime context names. When the user refers to "this page", "this GUI", or "this app" without naming another target, they mean this GUI. The browser provides no implicit DOM, route, or screenshot context. The client-plugin HMR receiver is active, but client-plugin changes reload without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is also running from this same checkout to rebuild their bundles; verify that watcher before promising automatic updates. Every other change — the apps/web shell and plain packages — requires rebuilding the affected Web artifacts and verifying this existing URL after a page refresh. Starting another server does not update this GUI. The apps/web Vite entry builds the shell but is not a standalone application because only dsh web injects window.__DSH_BOOT__. Do not start a replacement server unless the user asks; if one is needed, use a managed background job and verify its exact URL.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

agent.description: The name of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

375:  ### 2.4 续流生命周期
376:  
377:  | 场景 | 服务端行为 | 前端处理 |
378:  |---|---|---|
379:  | 正常回放 + 运行中 | 回放**已落库**事件后持续推实时帧 | 正常渲染；无帧时等待心跳；断线窗口的 delta 不补 |
380:  | 回放/实时收到 `message.done` 或 `error` | 立即关闭流 | 视为终态，**不重连**；用 `GET /runs/{id}` 刷新终态 |
381:  | run 已终态且回放里有终态事件 | 回放完立即关闭 | 收到终态事件后停止 |
382: -| run 已终态但回放里没有终态事件 | 回放完关闭（避免空挂） | 收到 EOF 后查一次 `GET /runs/{id}`，不要无限重连 |
383: -| `interrupted`（等待审批） | 保持连接，最多空闲 `HITL_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`（默认 900s），期间 15s 一次 `: ping` | 展示待审批卡片；收到 `run.resumed` 后继续渲染增量；服务端超时关闭后再按 `after_seq` 重连 |
384: +| run 已终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）但回放里没有终态事件 | 回放完直接关闭（避免空挂） | 收到 EOF 后查一次 `GET /runs/{id}`；确认终态则停止重连、不要无限重连，并在终态后拉消息终稿 |
385: +| `interrupted`（等待审批） | 保持连接，最多空闲 `HITL_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`（默认 900s），期间 15s 一次 `: ping` | 展示待审批卡片；收到 `run.resumed` 后继续渲染增量；**此阶段不要拉消息终稿**（消息 `status=streaming`，历史接口不返回），等恢复/取消至终态后再拉；服务端超时关闭后再按 `after_seq` 重连 |
386:  | 回放超过 1000 条 | 建流前返回 400 `replay_too_large`（不会开始 SSE） | 改用分页回放补历史，再以最新 `seq` 重连续流；不要把同一个 `after_seq` 原样重试 |
387:  | `after_seq` 非法（负数/超 int32/非整数） | 422 `validation_error` | 修正参数；不要自动重试 |
388:  | 未登录/令牌过期 | 401 `unauthorized` | 刷新令牌后从原 `lastSeq` 重试；刷新失败则登出 |
389:  | 非本人 run / 不存在 | 404 `not_found` | 停止重连，提示「运行不存在或无权访问」 |
390:  | 403 | 403 `forbidden`（通用；续流不要求管理员，当前正常路径不返回） | 停止重连，按通用无权限提示 |
391: -| run 已终态但回放无终态事件 | 回放完直接关闭 | 先 `GET /runs/{id}` 确认终态，停止重连并拉消息终稿 |
392: -| 断线期间产生的 `message.delta` | **不落库、不回放** | 无法补齐增量文本；终态/`interrupted` 后拉消息历史终稿覆盖 |
393: +| 断线期间产生的 `message.delta` | **不落库、不回放** | 无法补齐增量文本；run 进入终态后拉消息历史终稿覆盖（`interrupted` 期间历史接口不返回该消息） |
394:  
395:  > 心跳 `: ping` **不是事件**，不要写进消息列表，也不要因为 15s 没数据就主动断开。
396:  > 浏览器/网关的空闲超时要大于 15s（Nginx 已由 `X-Accel-Buffering: no` 关闭缓冲，仍建议
397:  > `proxy_read_timeout` ≥ 60s）。

**鉴权**：需要 `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`；非本人或不存在统一 404（不泄露存在性）。浏览器 `EventSource` 不支持自定义请求头，请用 `fetch`/`@microsoft/fetch-event-source` 携带 Bearer。

**续流**：先回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件（`after_seq` 默认 0），再订阅事件总线跟随实时事件；回放超过 1000 条返回 400 `replay_too_large`，请改用 `GET /runs/{id}/events?after_seq=` 分页回放，或传入更接近的 `after_seq`。

**回放边界**：`message.delta`/`reasoning.delta` 以 `persist=False` 发出，不写入`run_events`，断线窗口内的增量文本不会补发；只有 run 进入终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`，即收到 `message.done`/`error`，或 `interrupted` 后恢复/取消完成）后，才用 `GET /conversations/{id}/messages` 拉取助手消息终稿覆盖本地累积内容；`run.interrupted` 期间该消息 `messages.status` 仍为 `streaming`，历史接口不会返回。

**关闭**：收到终态事件（`message.done`/`error`）后立即关闭；run 已结束（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）且回放里没有终态事件时，回放完即关闭。`interrupted` 的 run 保持连接等待审批恢复，空闲超过 `HITL_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` 后关闭。

**重连**：本端点不读取 `Last-Event-ID` 请求头；若流以 EOF 结束且尚未收到终态事件，先查 `GET /runs/{id}`：已终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）时停止重连并刷新终稿；否则携带最后收到事件的 `id`/`seq` 作为 `after_seq` 重连，只补齐断线期间已落库的事件。

async def cancel_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunCancelResult:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status not in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
        raise RunNotCancelableError(run.status)
    now = _now()
    if run.status == "interrupted":
        # 等待审批中的 run 没有活跃任务：直接抢占状态、写终态并清理挂起线程。
        if not await cancel_interrupted_run(run_id, reason="user_canceled"):
            raise RunNotCancelableError(run.status)
        return RunCancelResult(id=run_id, status="canceled", canceled_at=now)
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = elapsed_ms(started_at, now)
    run.status = "canceled"
    run.canceled_at = now
    run.finished_at = now
    run.duration_ms = duration_ms
    run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
    await db.execute(
        update(Message)
        .where(Message.run_id == run_id, Message.status == "streaming")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.execute(
        update(Approval)
        .where(Approval.run_id == run_id, Approval.status == "pending")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.commit()
    registry.cancel(run_id)
    # 兜底：任务收尾后若 checkpoint 仍挂起（取消与挂起竞态），清理线程。
    _spawn_background(halt_run(run_id))
    return RunCancelResult(id=run.id, status="canceled", canceled_at=now)

So the contract "after run terminal, fetch history" is accurate for interrupted->canceled. The interrupted→resume→done path: `_finalize_success` sets completed. Good.

One nuance: when a run is interrupted and then resume fails (exception), `_finalize_failed` sets status failed? Let me quickly check `_finalize_failed` sets assistant.status. But terminal states generally finalize. Not critical.

Another nuance: "run 进入终态后才拉消息终稿" — but what about a *streaming* message in normal running state? History filters it. Right.

Potential subtle issue: run terminal set to succeeded but assistant finalization might race? Both in same transaction probably. Fine.

Now, finding 1 also has a location `app/modules/chat/router.py:111-114` and exported openapi `docs/openapi.json:2424`. Verify the final router.py text around `_RUN_STREAM_DESCRIPTION` shows the corrected wording (diff shows yes). And exported openapi shows the updated description (diff line 466 yes; grep output at openapi line 2424 shows updated text). Need to also check `_SSE_DESCRIPTION` in openapi.json at line 2424? Wait, the finding says exported `docs/openapi.json:2424` corresponds to `_RUN_STREAM_DESCRIPTION`, which is the second openapi hunk at ~2414. That's updated. The first hunk (~1887) updates POST /chat/stream description which contains the `_SSE_DESCRIPTION`. Both updated. Good.

Now check the *new* text in `_SSE_DESCRIPTION`: "挂起时已产出的内容会落库（`messages.status` 保持 `streaming`，run 终态后历史接口才返回）". Accurate.

But wait: the `_SSE_DESCRIPTION` is for POST /chat/stream. In interrupted case during live SSE, the client is connected; on resume/cancel they get events. Fine.

Now check wording subtlety: "只有 run 进入终态（succeeded/failed/canceled，即收到 message.done/error，或 interrupted 后恢复/取消完成）后，才用 GET /conversations/{id}/messages" — is `failed` always accompanied by `error` event? Probably yes or at least message.done with finish_reason failed? Let me check terminal events. `TERMINAL_EVENTS` includes message.done and error. The claim "即收到 message.done/error" is the mapping. If run failed but the client missed the terminal event, they still can check run status. The text says "即收到 message.done/error" — meaning the terminal event; might be slightly imprecise for failed runs with error events, but likely fine. Actually in the same `_RUN_STREAM_DESCRIPTION`, the "重连" paragraph says if EOF without terminal event, check GET /runs/{id}: if terminal, stop reconnect and refresh final message. So it handles missed terminal events. Good.

Now, potential new breakage introduced by the fix:
1. In handoff §2.4 lifecycle table: the row "run 已终态但回放里没有终态事件" now has "收到 EOF 后查一次 GET /runs/{id}；确认终态则停止重连、不要无限重连，并在终态后拉消息终稿". Good. Duplicate row removed. Need to check the table for formatting — the row added new text; table renders. Also need to check that no duplicate remains (the diff removed the later row at old line 268). grep the table lines 260-275 to see final state.

2. Did the fix introduce a contradiction in handoff §2.1? It says "只有 run 进入终态后才拉消息终稿：收到 message.done/error ... 后用 GET ... 拉取..." and next bullet interrupted. Good.

3. Check whether the previous re-review's outstanding issue about "interrupted 期间 reconnect only replays persisted events, no deltas" is reflected: The new handoff bullet says during interrupted wait for resume/timeout-cancel. Does it mention that reconnect only replays persisted events? The finding's required contract: "during interrupted the message is not returned by history and the client must wait for resume/timeout-cancel; reconnect only replays persisted events, no deltas." The reconnect-no-deltas part already existed. Fine.

Now check potential issues introduced:
- The api.md line about "run 进入终态（message.done/error，或 interrupted 后恢复/取消至终态）后" — in §7.7 replay boundary. The phrase "以 run 进入终态（message.done/error，或 interrupted 后恢复/取消至终态）后" is a bit awkward but fine.
- Could there be a factual error: "interrupted 期间该助手消息 messages.status 仍为 streaming" — yes.
- Could there be a new inconsistency: `docs/api.md` §10.2 says "run 进入终态后以消息历史终稿为准（interrupted 期间该消息 status=streaming，历史接口不返回）" — fine.
- handoff line 196: "run 仍运行 / interrupted ... 按最后 seq 退避重连" fine.
- handoff line 384? Let me view final handoff lines 250-275 and 240-260 to check table integrity.

Also check the `docs/openapi.json` consistency: the diff changes descriptions; but is the exported openapi in sync with router.py? The report claims export clean. I could run a focused check: `python -c "from app.main import app; import json; ..."` and compare `app.openapi()` with docs/openapi.json. That's acceptable per instructions ("focused OpenAPI consistency check is acceptable if a doubt arises"). There is doubt? Maybe not strong, but it's cheap and read-only. However, running python might be considered re-running tests? No, just import app. The report claims clean; diff shows both descriptions updated consistently in source and json. I can compare the two descriptions manually — they match? Let's check the router.py final text vs openapi text, which I can do via python for exact match. But careful: importing app may require env; report says export clean. A focused check is allowed. Let me consider whether there's doubt: the fix changed router description and openapi description; the diff lines look identical in content. Actually the diff for router and openapi both show the same new Chinese text. The openapi JSON contains `_RUN_STREAM_DESCRIPTION` as escaped. Looks consistent. I could still do a quick `python -c` compare of just the two strings to be safe. But read-only python import is fine. Hmm, but the task says "Do not re-run git commands" and "Read-only: do not mutate". Running export script would rewrite docs/openapi.json (mutating) — not allowed. Instead compare in memory: import app, get app.openapi(), compare against json file. `app.openapi()` doesn't write. That's a focused consistency check and read-only. But is there a risk importing app opens DB? Probably not; app import builds routes. Let me decide later.

Also, check other docs that might still state wrong contract: the finding 1 said "the docs" must only say... Locations listed. But maybe README/roadmap/architecture elsewhere still say "终态或 interrupted 后取终稿". Let me grep broadly for "终稿" across repo docs and code.

### 2.4 续流生命周期

| 场景 | 服务端行为 | 前端处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 正常回放 + 运行中 | 回放**已落库**事件后持续推实时帧 | 正常渲染；无帧时等待心跳；断线窗口的 delta 不补 |
| 回放/实时收到 `message.done` 或 `error` | 立即关闭流 | 视为终态，**不重连**；用 `GET /runs/{id}` 刷新终态 |
| run 已终态且回放里有终态事件 | 回放完立即关闭 | 收到终态事件后停止 |
| run 已终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）但回放里没有终态事件 | 回放完直接关闭（避免空挂） | 收到 EOF 后查一次 `GET /runs/{id}`；确认终态则停止重连、不要无限重连，并在终态后拉消息终稿 |
| `interrupted`（等待审批） | 保持连接，最多空闲 `HITL_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`（默认 900s），期间 15s 一次 `: ping` | 展示待审批卡片；收到 `run.resumed` 后继续渲染增量；**此阶段不要拉消息终稿**（消息 `status=streaming`，历史接口不返回），等恢复/取消至终态后再拉；服务端超时关闭后再按 `after_seq` 重连 |
| 回放超过 1000 条 | 建流前返回 400 `replay_too_large`（不会开始 SSE） | 改用分页回放补历史，再以最新 `seq` 重连续流；不要把同一个 `after_seq` 原样重试 |
| `after_seq` 非法（负数/超 int32/非整数） | 422 `validation_error` | 修正参数；不要自动重试 |
| 未登录/令牌过期 | 401 `unauthorized` | 刷新令牌后从原 `lastSeq` 重试；刷新失败则登出 |
| 非本人 run / 不存在 | 404 `not_found` | 停止重连，提示「运行不存在或无权访问」 |
| 403 | 403 `forbidden`（通用；续流不要求管理员，当前正常路径不返回） | 停止重连，按通用无权限提示 |
| 断线期间产生的 `message.delta` | **不落库、不回放** | 无法补齐增量文本；run 进入终态后拉消息历史终稿覆盖（`interrupted` 期间历史接口不返回该消息） |

> 心跳 `: ping` **不是事件**，不要写进消息列表，也不要因为 15s 没数据就主动断开。
> 浏览器/网关的空闲超时要大于 15s（Nginx 已由 `X-Accel-Buffering: no` 关闭缓冲，仍建议
> `proxy_read_timeout` ≥ 60s）。

But wait: line 60 comment "服务端已终态但回放中没有终态事件时回调（此时应停止重连并刷新终态/消息终稿）" fine.

|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/chat/stream` | 发送消息，SSE 流式返回 |
| GET | `/api/v1/runs/{run_id}` | 运行状态与用量 |
| GET | `/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/events` | 事件分页回放（不跟随实时流；每项含 `event` 原始事件名，M7） |
| GET | `/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/stream` | 运行事件 SSE 续流：先回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件，再跟随实时事件（M7） |
| POST | `/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | 取消运行 |
| POST | `/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/resume` | 恢复 `input-required` 的运行 |

> 续流端点鉴权：`Authorization: Bearer <access token>`；未登录/无效 token 401 `unauthorized`，
> 非本人或不存在统一 404 `not_found`（不泄露存在性），待回放事件 >1000 条 400 `replay_too_large`，
> `after_seq` 非法 422 `validation_error`；**不支持 `Last-Event-ID`**，重连必须显式传 `after_seq`。
> 回放只覆盖已落库事件：`message.delta`/`reasoning.delta` 不落 `run_events`，断线窗口内的增量
> 不会补发；run **进入终态**（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）后用
> `GET /conversations/{id}/messages` 取终稿覆盖。`run.interrupted` 期间助手消息仍为
> `messages.status=streaming`，历史接口不会返回，需等审批恢复或超时取消。详见 §7.8。

### 2.4 远程智能体（M2 已实现）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/agents/preview` | 拉取并校验 Agent Card，不落库（`{valid, card, normalized, warnings}`） |
| POST | `/api/v1/agents` | 注册远程 Agent（拉取 Agent Card；同 url+slug 幂等返回已有）（**仅管理员**） |
| GET | `/api/v1/agents` | 已注册 Agent 列表：`health_status`、`enabled`、`q`、`limit`、`cursor` + `stats` |
| GET | `/api/v1/agents/{id}` | Agent 详情（含原始 Card、skills、auth_hint、last_*、recent_tasks） |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/agents/{id}` | 修改 `{enabled?, name?, auth?{type,secret_ref}, headers?}`（headers 敏感头只存引用/密文）（**仅管理员**） |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/agents/{id}` | 软删除（有运行中任务 409 `agent_has_active_tasks`）（**仅管理员**） |
=== 700,750 ===

> 2026-11-09 热修：此前 cursor 编码把 ORM 的 `UUID` 对象直接交给 `json.dumps`，
> 只要 `has_more=true` 需要生成 `next_cursor` 就会 500。现在编码层统一把
> `UUID` / `datetime` 归一化为字符串，并新增会话/消息/审批分页回归测试。

### 7.7 运行事件回放（`GET /runs/{id}/events`）

| 字段 | 实际行为 |
|---|---|
| `id` | 形如 `<run_id>:<seq>` 的不透明字符串，不是 UUID |
| `seq` | 运行内递增，允许跳号（`message.delta` 不落库） |
| `type` | 事件分类（历史字段，取值不变） |
| `event` | 原始 SSE 事件名（M7 新增；由 `payload._event` 映射，未知/历史缺失时为 `""`） |
| `tokens` | 对象或 `null`，键始终存在 |
| `error` | 字符串摘要或 `null`，不是对象；结构化错误在 `message.done`/`error` 事件里 |
| `payload` | 已剔除内部字段 `_event`，其余与 SSE 帧 `data` 一致 |
| 过滤 | `after_seq`、`types`（逗号分隔）、`q`（标题/副标题模糊匹配）、`cursor` |
| 分页 | `after_seq` 与 `cursor` 可同时递增；`has_more=false` 即取完 |

> **回放边界（M7）**：本接口只返回已写入 `run_events` 的事件。`message.delta` 与
> `reasoning.delta` 以 `persist=False` 发送，**不落库、不可回放**；断线期间的增量文本永久缺失。
> 需要完整回复时，以 run 进入终态（`message.done`/`error`，或 `interrupted` 后恢复/取消至终态）后
> `GET /conversations/{id}/messages` 返回的消息正文为准。`run.interrupted` 期间该助手消息
> `messages.status` 仍为 `streaming`，历史接口不会返回。

### 7.8 运行续流与恢复端点

#### 7.8.1 SSE 续流（`GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=`，M7）

| 项 | 实际行为 |
|---|---|
| 鉴权 | `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`；未携带/无效/过期 401 `unauthorized` |
| 所有权 | run 不存在或不属于当前用户统一 404 `not_found`（不泄露存在性） |
| `after_seq` | 默认 0；只回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件，随后跟随实时事件；取值 `0..2147483647`，非法 422 `validation_error` |
| 回放上限 | 待回放事件 >1000 条在建流前返回 400 `replay_too_large`；改用 `GET /runs/{id}/events?after_seq=` 分页回放，或传入更接近的 `after_seq` |
| 终态关闭 | 回放或实时收到 `message.done`/`error` 后立即关闭；run 已终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）且回放里没有终态事件时，回放完即关闭 |
| `interrupted` | run 停在审批时保持连接等待 `run.resumed` 与后续事件；空闲超过 `HITL_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`（默认 900s）后关闭，客户端按最后 `seq` 重连 |
| 心跳 | 等待实时事件期间每 15s 发送注释帧 `: ping`，不占 `seq`，客户端忽略 |

| 回放边界 | 只回放已写入 `run_events` 的事件；`message.delta`/`reasoning.delta` 不落库、**断线期间不补发**；run 进入终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）后用 `GET /conversations/{id}/messages` 取终稿；`interrupted` 期间该消息 `status=streaming`，历史接口不返回 |

content.text:
- `after_seq`：只回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件，默认 `0`；回放结束后继续跟随实时事件。
  首次建连传 `0`；断线重连传**最后收到事件的 `id`/`seq`**。
- 服务端**不读取 `Last-Event-ID` 请求头**，重连必须显式传 `after_seq`。
- 响应头：`X-Run-ID`（被续流的 run）、`X-Request-ID`（排障用，错误体 `request_id` 与之一致）、
  `Cache-Control: no-cache`、`X-Accel-Buffering: no`。
- 帧格式与 `/chat/stream` 相同：`id: <seq>`、`event: <事件名>`、`data: <单行 JSON>`；
  心跳是注释帧 `: ping`（每 15s，不占 `seq`）。
- **回放只覆盖已写入 `run_events` 的事件**：`message.delta` / `reasoning.delta` 以
  `persist=False` 发出，不落库，断线窗口内的增量文本**不会补发**。重连后只从服务端当前实时点继续。
- **只有 run 进入终态后才拉消息终稿**：收到 `message.done`/`error`（run 为
  `succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）后，用
  `GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages` 拉取该条助手消息的终稿覆盖本地累积文本。
- **`run.interrupted` 期间不要拉消息终稿**：此时助手消息内容虽已落库，但 `messages.status` 仍为
  `streaming`，历史接口会过滤掉它、**不会返回该消息**；需等审批恢复（`run.resumed` → 后续终态）
  或审批超时取消、run 进入终态后再拉取。

### 2.2 推荐接入方式（`@microsoft/fetch-event-source`）

```ts
// 依赖：pnpm add @microsoft/fetch-event-source
import { fetchEventSource } from '@microsoft/fetch-event-source'
=== 180,205 ===

  void loop()
  return { close: () => ctrl.abort(), getLastSeq: () => lastSeq }
}
```

说明：

- 每收到一帧就把 `ev.id` 记为 `lastSeq`（`id` 就是 `seq`，纯数字）；重连时作为 `after_seq`，
  服务端只回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件。示例在 `onmessage` 里显式丢弃 `seq <= lastSeq`
  的重复帧，防止重连窗口导致消息重复。
- 收到 `message.done` / `error`：属于终态事件，**不要重连**；UI 以 `GET /api/v1/runs/{id}` 的终态为准，
  并用 `GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` 拉取助手消息终稿，覆盖本地累积的增量文本。
- EOF 且未收到终态事件时分两种：
  1. **run 已终态**（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`）但回放里没有终态事件：服务端回放完就关闭，
     示例会先查 `GET /runs/{id}`，命中终态则停止重连并回调 `onRunEnd`；
  2. **run 仍运行 / `interrupted`**（或状态查询失败）：按最后 `seq` 退避重连；`interrupted` 连上后
     继续等审批恢复。
- 单实例部署：后端事件总线是进程内实现。多实例/重部署时实时帧可能丢失，重连后的回放只能补齐
  **已落库**事件；`message.delta`/`reasoning.delta` 不落库，断线窗口的增量文本不补，需在 run
  进入终态后靠消息历史终稿覆盖（`interrupted` 期间历史接口不返回该消息）。

### 2.3 用原生 `fetch` 接入（无第三方依赖）

关键点：`fetch` 的 `response.body` 是 `ReadableStream`，按 `\n\n` 切帧；跳过 `:` 开头的注释帧；

**回放边界**：`message.delta`/`reasoning.delta` 以 `persist=False` 发出，不写入`run_events`，断线窗口内的增量文本不会补发；只有 run 进入终态（`succeeded`/`failed`/`canceled`，即收到 `message.done`/`error`，或 `interrupted` 后恢复/取消完成）后，才用 `GET /conversations/{id}/messages` 拉取助手消息终稿覆盖本地累积内容；`run.interrupted` 期间该消息 `messages.status` 仍为 `streaming`，历史接口不会返回。

async def _finalize_success(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    assistant_message_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    duration_ms: int,
    finished_at: datetime,
    citations: list[dict],
) -> bool:
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        assistant = await db.get(Message, assistant_message_id)
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is not None and run.status == "canceled":
            if assistant is not None:
                assistant.content = content
                assistant.status = "canceled"
                assistant.usage = usage
                assistant.citations = citations
            await db.commit()
            return False
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "completed"
            assistant.usage = usage
            assistant.citations = citations
        if run is not None:
            run.status = "succeeded"
            run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
            run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
            run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
            run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
            run.duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.finished_at = finished_at
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            if conversation is not None:
                conversation.last_message_at = finished_at
                conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80]
                conversation.message_count += 1
        model_name = run.model if run is not None else ""
        await db.commit()
    trace.get_current_span().set_attribute("app.run.status", "succeeded")
    record_chat_run(
        "succeeded",
        duration_ms / 1000,
        first_token_ms / 1000 if first_token_ms is not None else None,
        model_name,
    )
    return True
